title: New York Chocolate Egg Cream with Seltzer
summary: Chocolate syrup and cold milk are stirred together in a chilled glass, then cold seltzer is poured in while stirring hard until a thick foam rises.

ingredients.item: plain seltzer or soda water, very cold, from a freshly opened bottle

steps.title: Mix the base
steps.text: Spoon 2 tbsp chocolate syrup into the bottom of each chilled glass and pour 80 ml cold milk on top. Stir with the long spoon until evenly combined.

steps.title: Add the fizz
steps.text: Pour about 160 ml seltzer into each glass in a steady stream while stirring hard for about 30 seconds, until a thick white foam rises to the top.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Drink immediately, topping up with a splash more seltzer as the foam settles.

tips: Chill the glasses in the freezer for 10 minutes for a better foam.
A freshly opened bottle of seltzer gives the most bubbles and the tallest head.
Whole milk makes a richer, more stable foam than skimmed.
For a vanilla egg cream, use vanilla syrup instead of chocolate syrup.
storage: Not suitable for storing; it goes flat within minutes. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
